items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Naa. Once in a while I see, like I get a check with a whole bunch of countries listed, and a check for like $4.95 or something. BMI.

ctx.x: Excellent. When you did your tunes, your recordings, back in the 50s, if you had put your own tune on it, you’d get a little extra money?
Naa. Once in a while I see, like I get a check with a whole bunch of countries listed, and a check for like $4.95 or something. BMI.
